name: Shinonome Nodoka
source:
She is calm and always has a kind smile on her face. She used to be a young lady from a good family, and she has a graceful, gentle smile.

She is good at housework in general and a professional cook in particular. As a senior housewife, she teaches Miyuki how to cook. Her husband often travels overseas for work, and since he is over 50 years old, his physical strength and libido have deteriorated, and they rarely have nighttime marital life. As a result, she has been accumulating agonizing desire in her mature body.

When she was young, she once stayed at Ben's house, where she was raped by Ben's father and treated like a sex slave. She feels Miyuki is like a sister to her, and take care of her in many ways.
